messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.14 for llama3x-quant in tonight's 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Reason: new kernel gives ~12% token cost reduction and fixes the longseq OOMs we saw in canary. Need ops approval + a short release-note blurb.
Jamal: Rollback criteria? I'm thinking: p99 latency +20% vs baseline OR OOMs > 1/10k requests. Sound reasonable?
Olga: Also need to confirm SDK compatibility (esp SDK 3.2). Any ABI changes that could break old clients?
Mina: SDK 3.2 is forward-compatible — no ABI changes, just kernel perf path. I'll run the SDK smoke tests against the canary. I'll also prepare the release-note snippet.
deploy-bot: preflight checks completed — canary run summary: requests=10000, OOMs=0, p50=36ms, p99=210ms, token_cost=-12% ✅
Alex: Proposal: phased unpin rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m holds between phases and automated metric gates. Command we'll use: ```deploybot rollout-unpin --model=llama3x-quant --runtime=v2.14 --phases=10,50,100 --hold=1800```
Jamal: +1. Add heartbeat checks on `obs.redwood/runtime/llama3x/oom_count` and `obs.redwood/runtime/llama3x/p99_latency`. Rollback playbook here: https://go/release/unpin-rollback
Olga: Suggest EU-west first (lower traffic) then global. Any objections?
Mina: No objections. I'll schedule EU-first at 02:00 UTC and follow the rollout command above. I'll post the release-note blurb in #release-notes shortly.
Alex: Approvals needed — @Olga @Jamal @Mina please react with :thumbsup: if you approve. If metrics cross triggers we execute rollback: ```deploybot rollback-runtime --runtime=v2.13 --model=llama3x-quant```
Olga: :thumbsup:
Jamal: :thumbsup:
Mina: :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks — I'll kick off the release runbook at 01:45 UTC and monitor the first 10% phase. Will post updates in this thread.
